$comment: site.consent is { labels: { preferences, title, save, cancel }, categories: [{ id, label, description }] }. state.consentPanelOpen draws the dialog. The dialog carries open: it is drawn only when open (SC-019). The consent-description element has no declared children, so the description is plain text inside it. The consent-save and consent-cancel buttons are button-form components with their label as text.
summary: The consent preferences panel open: its dialog with a title, two categories (analytics, marketing) each with checkbox, label and description, and save and cancel buttons, beside the footer's links and consent control.
